The '''Ilimardon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Nicandra sector/Legends|Nicandra sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ilimardon]].
